HOWTO Disable Cortana

On Win10 Pro or Enterprise

1. Run Local Group Policy editor, either run gpedit.msc or type group policy into search

2. Go to Computer Config > Administrative Templates > Windows Components > Search

3. On the right pane disable 'Allow Cortana' and 'Allow Cortana above lock screen'


On Win10 Home


1. Run regedit

2. Go to HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search

3. On right pane create a new DWORD (32-bit) value and name it 'AllowCortana' and set it to 0

General Win10 privacy

1. Use a local account or domain account, do not use an Microsoft account which is pushed by default.

2. Turn off Location service under Settings -> Privacy -> Location

3. Turn off Advertising ID under Settings -> Privacy -> General

4. Under Settings -> Privacy -> Diagnostics & Feedback, set it to Basic and turn off everything else

5. Under Settings -> Privacy -> Active History, uncheck everything and turn off any history for accounts

6. Under Settings -> Privacy -> Speach, inking, & typing make sure its turned off

7. Under Settings -> Privacy -> Camera/Mic/Account Info, restrict access only to apps that need it if any

You can also use 'AntiSpy for Windows 10' to control and turn off all the privacy/spy/telemetry options from one place
